title: 형만큼 커요? 노력한 만큼 늘어요: 만큼 · -는 만큼
objective: By the end, you can compare two things as being "the same degree" with N만큼, and say "as much as you do/did/will do" with -는 만큼, -(으)ㄴ 만큼 and -(으)ㄹ 만큼, using the right form and spacing.
summary: Learn to say "as much as" in Korean, with the particle 만큼 after nouns and -는/-(으)ㄴ/-(으)ㄹ 만큼 after verbs and adjectives.

task.title: Use 만큼 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then choose, change, fix, or answer using 만큼 or -는 만큼 as the instructions say.

forms.when: After a noun. 만큼 is a particle, so write it attached to the noun.
forms.means: as ... as N (the same degree as N). With a negative (안, 못), it means 'not as ... as N'.
forms.example: 제 동생도 이제 형만큼 키가 커요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My younger brother is now as tall as our older brother.

forms.when: After a verb, for something that happens now or usually. Put a space before 만큼.
forms.means: as much as (someone) does; the more you do, the more ...
forms.exampleMeaning: Your body gets better as much as you exercise.

forms.when: After a verb, for something already done.
forms.exampleMeaning: My grades went up as much as I studied.

forms.when: After a verb, for an amount that will be done or is needed. Often used with 만 (only).
forms.means: as much as (someone) will do / is going to need
forms.exampleMeaning: Take only as much as you will eat.

forms.when: After an adjective, for a present state. Do not use -는 with adjectives (exception: adjectives ending in 있다/없다 take -는, e.g. 재미있는 만큼).
forms.exampleMeaning: This restaurant is as tasty as it is expensive.

watchOut: 형 만큼 (X) → 형만큼 (O): After a noun, 만큼 is a particle. No space.
먹는만큼 (X) → 먹는 만큼 (O): After a verb or adjective, put a space before 만큼.
바쁘는 만큼 (X) → 바쁜 만큼 (O): Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ 만큼, not -는 만큼.
보다 = 'than' (comparison), 만큼 = 'as ... as' (same degree). To say 'as tall as my brother', use 형만큼 커요, not 형보다 커요, which means 'taller than my brother'.
exercises: Fill in each blank with 만큼 or 보다 to match the English: ① 오늘은 어제____ 추워요. (It is as cold as yesterday.) ② 지하철이 버스____ 빨라요. (The subway is faster than the bus.)

Change the word in brackets into the right form before 만큼: ① 매일 (연습하다) ____ 만큼 실력이 늘었어요. (already done) ② 오늘 (쓰다) ____ 만큼만 사세요. (amount you will use) ③ 아이들이 (웃다) ____ 만큼 우리도 행복해요. (happening now) ④ 방이 (넓다) ____ 만큼 월세도 비싸요.
Fix the spacing: ① 딸이 벌써 엄마 만큼 키가 컸어요. ② 준비한만큼 발표가 잘됐어요.
Read the sentence and choose what is true: 저는 형만큼 수영을 잘하지 못해요. (a) I swim better than my brother. (b) My brother swims better than me. (c) We swim equally well.
Answer in Korean with 만큼. Use the hint. 한국 음식이 많이 매워요? (Hint: as spicy as Mexican food — 멕시코 음식)
answers: ① 연습한 ② 쓸 ③ 웃는 ④ 넓은
① 딸이 벌써 엄마만큼 키가 컸어요. ② 준비한 만큼 발표가 잘됐어요.
(b) My brother swims better than me.
네, 멕시코 음식만큼 매워요. (네, 한국 음식은 멕시코 음식만큼 매워요.)
